meta.name: humanize
meta.description: Use whenever the user asks to "humanize", "make this sound more human", "rewrite to avoid AI detection", "make this less AI-sounding", "add a human voice", or "write like a person". Also use when the user pastes text and asks why it reads as robotic, generic, flat, or AI-like, or when generating new text in a register where AI tells (em dashes, semicolons, hedges, banned vocabulary like "delve", "leverage", "robust") would damage credibility.

copy.tagline: 把生硬文字改得像真人写的
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让AI生成或机械的文字更自然、有人情味。
